objects.name: Analytic 2278
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol master-role traffic originating from a Windows host that is not the authorized Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) or Distributed Control System (DCS) server. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the master/station identity or source is not authorized for the target device and command function, or when a normally authorized master violates its configured role/sequence and produces a corroborating device/process-state change. Suppress legitimate redundancy/failover, hot-standby promotion, commissioning, and approved engineering master activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: EventCode=3 unexpected Windows host opening Industrial Control Systems (ICS) protocol connections to multiple field device Internet Protocol (IP) addresses in polling pattern characteristic of master station

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: IP/identity allowlist of legitimate master/control server systems.
Inventory of authorized station/master addresses for protocols using logical addressing distinct from IP.
Time window within which command traffic to multiple devices from a single unrecognized source is considered a coordinated rogue master event.
